question: An effect says 'Prevent all damage creatures would deal this turn.' Does it apply to damage from permanents that become creatures later in the turn?

expected.shortAnswer: Yes: it modifies the rules of the game, so it applies even to damage from creatures that were not there when it began.
expected.answer: An effect that reads “Prevent all damage creatures would deal this turn” doesn’t modify any object’s characteristics, so it’s modifying the rules of the game. That means the effect will apply even to damage from creatures that weren’t on the battlefield when the continuous effect began. It also affects damage from permanents that become creatures later in the turn.
